weekly_prediction_contract_RCA.symptom: Fresh real weekly predictions would be refused as a schedule identity mismatch.
weekly_prediction_contract_RCA.cause: The consumer required prediction status to equal full-schedule status, but week_game_rows deliberately omits status and the weekly JSON schema forbids it.
weekly_prediction_contract_RCA.test_escape: Synthetic period fixtures used full-schedule rows as weekly predictions, supplying an impossible status field.
weekly_prediction_contract_RCA.fix: The full captured schedule owns status. Weekly rows must match week, matchup and kickoff; contrary explicit status, including null, is still refused.
weekly_prediction_contract_RCA.regression: Fixtures now call the actual week_game_rows producer and validate its output against the weekly schema. Two explicit-status negatives bring the exact refusal matrix to24.
